background_story: Cecelia was a brilliant audio engineer with a passion for preserving the integrity of sound. She spent years perfecting her craft, studying the intricacies of digital audio and the nuances of human hearing. Cecelia's obsession was to create a system that could compress audio files without sacrificing any of the original quality - a truly lossless format. After years of tireless work, she finally succeeded in developing a revolutionary new codec that could compress audio to a fraction of its original size without losing a single detail. Her breakthrough sent shockwaves through the music industry, and she became a hero to audiophiles and musicians around the world. Cecelia's work ensured that the beauty and emotion of music could be preserved forever, without compromise.
